build_summary.creator_opinion: A high-damage, high-penetration PvP build centered around the Palace Tachi medium weapon. By pairing high Charisma pre-shrine talents with Shadowcast's large manapool and Contractor's execute capability, this build maxes out armor penetration and inflicts devastating critical attacks.
strengths: Extremely high armor penetration from Charisma talents like Cult of Personality
Guaranteed execution on critical attacks thanks to Contractor Oath
Massive mantra hitboxes enabled by abundant ether and modification gems
Palace Tachi critical attack breaks guards frequently
weaknesses: Palace Tachi has a relatively slow swing speed
Low Agility limits passive mobility options

talents.name: Cult of Personality
talents.description: Gains +3% PEN for each person Charmed, capping at +15% PEN.

talents.name: Cornered Fool
talents.description: Blockbreaking a Charmed opponent procs Twisted for 5s, making them take and deal more damage.

talents.name: Etherguard
talents.description: Grants extra resistances to mantras based on ether cost.

talents.name: Critical Heal
talents.description: Chance to proc a critical heal when healing.

key_combos: Charm opponent from distance -> Palace Tachi Critical Attack (Guardbreak) -> Proc Twisted (Cornered Fool) -> Contractor Execution
combos_and_playstyle.playstyle_tips: Charm opponents from far away using high Charisma/Sing skills to max out penetration stacks via Cult of Personality. Abuse the guardbreak on the Palace Tachi crit to trigger Cornered Fool and finish off players instantly using Contractor's execute critical.
